d:
Bihar Space Technology : patna men ‘Space for Bihar’ karyakram ki shuruaat ho gaee hai. mukhyamantri samrat chaudhri ne do divsiy karyakram ka udghatan kiya. is karyakram men spes teknoloji ke upyog, vistar aur bihar men antriksh taknik ki sanbhavnaon par charcha ki ja rahi hai.
Kya spes teknoloji bihar ke vikas ko naee disha de sakti hai? antriksh taknik ka istemal kin kshetron men barhaya ja sakta hai? janie ‘Space for Bihar’ karyakram se juri puri jankari is riport men.
Bihar ki rajniti, vikas aur bari khabron ke lie hamare chainal ko sabsakraib karen.
